title: [review] provisioning.py:553: Docstring claims ACK veri
description: The docstring for provision_node() states '4. Verifies the ACK' but the method returns at line 591 immediately after sending the encrypted seed. ACK verification actually happens later in _handle_br_post() when the node sends a separate POST. This documentation mismatch could mislead callers into thinking the returned seed is fully verified when it is not.
